label: Rival: some POTENCY_1 in a respect is… alternative to Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to POTENCY_1…
note: Class: countermodel/inconsistency, partial. Aristotle's reply (Metaphysics XII.6, 1071b23-31: nothing would be; matter does not move itself) needs STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-BEING-IN-ACT and covers only potencies that are being actualized; #352 (docs/act-potency-theory.md, finding 4) shows the reduction principle leaves a potency in a respect in which nothing is in act. Not refuted.
